querystring.select: SELECT C.VENDOR_NAME AS SurveyorHo, B.DESCR AS Atype, A.RESERVED_FIELD_2 AS MaxTaskLoad, A.VENDOR_PARENT_ID AS VendorParentId
querystring.from: FROM dbo.VENDOR A WITH(NOLOCK) LEFT JOIN dbo.REF_MASTER B WITH(NOLOCK) ON A.RESERVED_FIELD_9 = B.MASTER_CODE JOIN dbo.VENDOR C WITH(NOLOCK) ON A.VENDOR_PARENT_ID = C.VENDOR_ID
querystring.where: WHERE A.MR_VENDOR_CLASS = N'BRANCH' AND  A.MR_VENDOR_CATEGORY_CODE = N'SURVEYOR_BRANCH' AND   A.VENDOR_ID = {0} AND B.REF_MASTER_TYPE_CODE = N'ASSGMNT_TYPE'
